description: Accessible sections and page templates for marketing websites, installed with the shadcn CLI. React 19, Base UI, Tailwind CSS v4, WCAG 2.2 AA.
rules: Install items with the shadcn CLI: npx shadcn@latest add @facade/<name>, or by URL https://facadeui.dev/r/<name>.json
Import styles/facade-tokens.css in your global stylesheet after tailwindcss; every section needs it
Use the page's outline: one h1, then pass headingLevel={2} to sections; visual size is a separate prop
Pass next/link and next/image through the link and image props; sections import nothing from next/*
The -motion variant of a section needs FacadeMotionProvider near the root and a client boundary when passing icons
